Notes:
(i) The Group has reviewed its disputed liabilities and proceedings and does not expect material impact on
financial position of the Group.
(ii) The Group had provided corporate guarantees of ` 56,793 lakhs to two suppliers on behalf of subsidiary for
business purpose. The guarantee provided to one supplier is without any specified limit.
*The Custom duty cases include cases where Search was conducted by Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI)
at the premises of the Holding Company and its two Subsidiary Companies on 20th December, 2021, 24th December,
2021 and 24th January, 2024. During the investigation, questions were raised regarding the interpretation of the
classification of imported goods. In respect of the search conducted at the Holding Company, a Show Cause Notice
(SCN) was received from the Department in an earlier year. In respect of the search conducted at one of the
Subsidiary Companies on 24th December, 2021, the Subsidiary Company had made an ad-hoc deposit of ` 700 Lakhs
to avoid any unnecessary business interruption. A Show Cause Notice (SCN) was received from the Department in
the previous financial year, wherein a demand of ` 624 Lakhs was raised. The matter was adjudicated during the
current year and an order was passed in favour of the Subsidiary Company. Consequently, the ad-hoc deposit of
` 700 Lakhs became refundable and has been subsequently received by the Subsidiary Company. In respect of the
search conducted at the other Subsidiary Company on 24th January, 2024, the Subsidiary Company had made an
ad-hoc deposit of ` 776 Lakhs, which was charged to the Statement of Profit and Loss in an earlier year. During the
current year, this Subsidiary Company has received a Show Cause Notice (SCN) from the Department proposing a
demand of ` 3,492 Lakhs. The Subsidiary Company has a strong case on merits and is in the process of filing its reply
against the said SCN. Pending final adjudication, the net amount of ` 2,716 Lakhs, after adjusting the ad-hoc deposit
of ` 776 Lakhs, has been disclosed as a contingent liability as at 31st March, 2026. The management is of the view
that the Holding Company and the Subsidiary Company are in compliance with applicable laws and have strong
grounds to succeed against any dispute or demand and accordingly, no liability is expected to arise.
